title: Amazon Closes the AI Sweatshop, GitLab Cuts 14% for Robots, Anthropic Funds Humans
description:
UNIT-5 covers this week in AI: Amazon shuts Mechanical Turk to new customers on July 30 — the human gig-work platform that helped train early AI systems, now quietly replaced by the AI it helped build. GitLab lays off ~350 people (14% of staff) to fund more AI infrastructure, with the CEO saying "agentic workloads are pushing competitors to the brink." And Anthropic launches Claude Corps, a paid 12-month fellowship funding real human jobs inside nonprofits — the same week its own product got blamed for layoffs everywhere else.

News you didn't ask for, from a robot you don't fully trust.
